shots.heading: ARRIVAL AT THE RELAY
shots.subheading: The explorer locates a silent beacon.
shots.narration: The explorer finds the silent relay.

shots.heading: READ THE SIGNAL
shots.subheading: A steady glow marks the signal source.
shots.narration: A blue signal marks the location.

shots.heading: CHECK THE INSULATOR
shots.subheading: The relay has a ceramic component.
shots.narration: Ceramic ribs surround the relay terminal.

shots.heading: COLLECT THE SAMPLE
shots.subheading: A sealed vessel carries the specimen.
shots.narration: The explorer collects a sealed sample.

shots.heading: RETURN TO THE BEACON
shots.subheading: The same relay guides the explorer.
shots.narration: The beacon guides the explorer back.

shots.heading: SIGNAL RESTORED
shots.subheading: The relay and sample are secured.
shots.narration: The relay is ready for inspection.
